newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices fall at auction.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices fall at auction.

text.p: Bangladesh tea prices fell further on a lack of demand from overseas buyers at the weekly auction on Tuesday, brokers said.
This pushed prices for mainly large and bold brokens sharply lower. However, all other grades attracted increased demand from blenders and local small buyers.
The average price was 56.44 taka per kg, down 1.91 from the previous sale.
Some 721,050 kilos were sold at the auction. The next sale will be on June 24 with an offer of 1.045 million kilos. ($ 1=43.65 taka)
